name: MCEMENT
recent: Malayan Cement 于2026年11月19日公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，净利按年增长13.5%。公司持续因雇员认股计划（ESOS）行使而小额发行新股，并公告将于2026年12月3日召开第76届常年股东大会。近期新闻关注燃料成本上升对利润的影响。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，净利按年增长13.5%。
将于2026年12月3日召开第76届常年股东大会。
数项公告涉及雇员认股计划（ESOS）行使而发行新股。
risks: 新闻标题提及燃料成本上升可能影响利润。
大股东 Prudential PLC 和 Eastspring Investments 近期有股权变动申报。
earnings: 2026财年第一季度（截至2026年9月30日）营收为13.30363亿令吉，按年增长9.5%，按季增长2.9%；净利为2.27561亿令吉，按年增长13.5%，按季增长2.1%；净利率为17.1%，上季度为17.2%。

recent_en: Malayan Cement announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November 2026, with net profit rising 13.5% year-on-year. The company continued to issue small numbers of new shares from the exercise of ESOS options and announced that its 76th Annual General Meeting will be held on 3 December 2026. Recent news focused on the impact of higher fuel costs on profits.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit up 13.5% year-on-year.
Several announcements related to the issuance of new shares from the exercise of ESOS options.
risks_en: News headlines mentioned that higher fuel costs may affect profits.
Substantial shareholders Prudential PLC and Eastspring Investments recently filed changes in their shareholdings.
earnings_en: For 1QFY2026 (ended 30 September 2026), revenue was RM1,330.363 million, up 9.5% year-on-year and 2.9% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM227.561 million, up 13.5% year-on-year and 2.1% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 17.1% versus 17.2% in the previous quarter.
